title: Managed Backup: invoice maturity
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines invoice maturity.

## Tier basis

**Invoice payment maturity period.** Calendar days after invoice issue for payment maturity; integer.

| Contract tier | Invoice payment maturity period |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 30 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, invoice payment maturity period is 30.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, invoice payment maturity period stays the same.
